capabilities: Render a monthly calendar over daily notes with photo covers, mood marks, and weather icons
Browse and full-text search entries in a timeline filtered by date, mood, tags, and media type
Record five-level moods with notes, tags, trend charts, and reports
Fetch weather from Open-Meteo and show on-this-day past-year recaps
Back up, restore, and export mood metadata as JSON or CSV
extras: Also installable via BRAT (Haoo-7/Obsidian-Dayline) or manual download. Mood data is stored by default in a separate Calendar/journal-metadata.json, not in the notes; EXIF GPS coordinates are only sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim if the user enables it. Weather needs no API key. Requires Obsidian v1.5.0+.
problem: Daily notes are plain files, so Obsidian offers no calendar or timeline view for browsing past entries with mood, weather, and media context.

relations.evidence: 缺少笔记时，确认一次就会按 Daily Notes 模板创建（支持 Templater）
天气功能可选，使用 Open-Meteo 且不需要 API Key
先使用 Day One Importer 或 Obsidian Importer，再把输出目录添加为 Journal source
将 EXIF GPS 坐标发送到 OpenStreetMap Nominatim 以显示地名
Dayline 会迁移旧 dayline 或 Calendar Sidebar 1.x 的设置

summary: Visual journal that turns a folder of Markdown daily notes into a monthly calendar and searchable timeline with mood, weather, and photo views.
